project_structure: Monorepo with apps/web (Next.js frontend) and apps/api (NestJS backend). Frontend uses Apollo Client for GraphQL queries, ECharts for visualization, and Ant Design for UI components. Dashboard is the primary integration point at apps/web/app/(app)/dashboard/ with modular chart components. Backend exposes GraphQL resolvers for items (with entities), economic data (Akshare), and analysis (correlation/anomaly). Data flows: ProcessedItem.entities (news entities) via items resolver, EconomicData via akshare service, AnalysisService for correlation analysis.

relevant_files.rationale: Primary UI integration point - dashboard layout where EntityImpactGraph component should be added alongside existing charts (WarMap, SectorHeatmap, FinancialCandlestick)
ECharts wrapper component with lazy loading, theme support, and module auto-detection - use as base for force-directed graph visualization
Defines ProcessedItemPreviewModelGraph with entities: string[] field (line 169-170) - source of news entity data
Items resolver that normalizes and returns entities from ProcessedItem - existing API for entity data
getEconomicData query (line 20-42) - existing API for financial/economic data from Akshare
Hook pattern for fetching economic data with time range - reference for creating useEntityImpactGraph hook
Existing correlation analysis service (submitCorrelation, runCorrelation) - potential backend for entity-financial correlation calculation
Existing correlation analysis UI with CorrelationAnalysisInput - reference for correlation request pattern
Shows how entities are fetched and displayed from processedPreview.entities (line 142, 479-485)
eventGroups query returns entities array (line 83) - alternative entity aggregation endpoint
Generated GraphQL types including entities field in ProcessedItemPreviewModelGraph and ItemsQuery
Directory for dashboard chart components (sector-heatmap, war-map, financial-candlestick) - location for new EntityImpactGraph component

patterns: 1) Dynamic imports with next/dynamic for chart components with Skeleton loading states; 2) ECharts wrapper (DashboardChart) with lazy module loading and theme registration; 3) GraphQL hooks from @/graphql/generated for data fetching; 4) Custom hooks (useEconomicData) for data transformation and state management; 5) Card-based layout with glass-panel styling for chart containers; 6) Time range from useDashboardRangeStore for date filtering; 7) Entity normalization in resolver (normalizeEntityNames function)
dependencies: Frontend: echarts/core with modular chart imports, @apollo/client for GraphQL, antd for UI, next/dynamic for code splitting. Backend: @nestjs/graphql for resolvers, @prisma/client for database, bullmq for job queues. Shared: GraphQL schema with ProcessedItemPreviewModelGraph.entities and EconomicDataPointModel. ECharts supports force-directed graph via 'graph' series type (not currently installed but available).
integration_points: UI Integration: apps/web/app/(app)/dashboard/dashboard-content.tsx:307-322 (grid section with WarMap and SectorHeatmap - add EntityImpactGraph as new panel). Data API - Entities: apps/api/src/graphql/resolvers/items.resolver.ts (existing items query returns entities via processedPreview.entities). Data API - Financial: apps/api/src/graphql/resolvers/economic-data.resolver.ts:20-42 (getEconomicData query). Correlation Service: apps/api/src/modules/analysis/analysis.service.ts:32-47 (submitCorrelation for entity-financial correlation). New GraphQL Query needed: getEntityFinancialCorrelation(entities: [String!], financialSlugs: [String!], timeRange: DateRangeInput) to compute co-occurrence and time correlation. Hook Pattern: apps/web/hooks/useEconomicData.ts (reference for useEntityImpactGraph hook). Chart Component: apps/web/components/echart.client.tsx (extend with 'graph' series type support at line 192-277).
constraints: 1) ECharts graph series type not currently in ensureOptionModules - needs addition for force-directed layout; 2) No existing entity-financial correlation API - requires new GraphQL query and backend service; 3) Entity data is string[] without structured metadata (no entity type classification); 4) Co-occurrence calculation needs to be implemented (entities appearing in same news items as financial tickers); 5) Time correlation requires aligning news timestamps with financial data timestamps; 6) Performance consideration: large entity sets may need pagination or top-N filtering; 7) Dashboard layout already dense - need to determine optimal placement (possibly replace or augment existing panel)

clarification_needs.question: Where should the Entity Impact Graph be placed in the dashboard layout?
clarification_needs.context: The dashboard has a 3-column grid layout with WarMap (2 cols), SectorHeatmap (1 col), GlobalSentimentTrend (2 cols), and FinancialCandlestick (1 col). Need to determine optimal placement for the new visualization.
options: Add as new row below existing charts (full width or 2-column span)
Add to right sidebar alongside AnalysisStream and AlertPanel
Create new dedicated page/tab for Entity Impact Graph

clarification_needs.question: How should entity-financial correlation be calculated?
clarification_needs.context: System has news entities (strings like person/organization names) and financial data (stock prices, commodities from Akshare). Need to define the correlation logic.
options: Co-occurrence frequency: count how often entity appears in news mentioning same ticker/sector
Time-based correlation: statistical correlation between entity mention frequency and price movements
Hybrid approach: combine co-occurrence with time-lagged correlation analysis
Use existing AnalysisService.submitCorrelation with LLM-based analysis

clarification_needs.question: Should a new backend API be created for entity-financial graph data?
clarification_needs.context: Current APIs return entities and financial data separately. A dedicated API could pre-compute graph nodes/edges for better performance.
options: Create new GraphQL query getEntityImpactGraph returning pre-computed nodes and edges
Fetch entities and financial data separately, compute graph structure in frontend
Extend existing eventGroups query to include financial correlation data

_metadata.task_description: GOAL: 创建交互式影响图谱 (Entity Impact Graph) - 力导向图可视化新闻实体与金融标的之间的关联关系. SCOPE: 1) 节点类型：新闻关键人物/机构 (from ProcessedItem Entities) + 金融标的（股票/大宗商品 from Akshare Data）; 2) 连线逻辑：基于共现频率或时间相关性（Correlation Analysis）; 3) 交互功能：用户可直观看到实体如何通过板块传导影响价格
